about: Held-out check: 25 popular Audible Genius presets from PresetShare, never used for tuning. Each is rendered from its own MIDI demo in Primer and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization.

patches.title: Donna Summer - I Feel Love
notes: FM with a non-sine modulator and the sub on: Vital phase-modulates by osc 2 directly (brighter than Primer's FM)
FM depth matched at MIDI note 39 (Primer FM varies with the note)

patches.title: Drake - What's Next
notes: FM depth matched at MIDI note 64 (Primer FM varies with the note)
ring mod and FM both on: Vital osc 1 has one morph slot; FM kept, ring mod dropped

patches.title: George Michael - Fastlove
notes: mod wheel -> LFO amount with LFO amount 0: Vital routing amount unknown, not converted

patches.title: Sash! - Encore Un Fois
notes: FM with a non-sine modulator and the sub on: Vital phase-modulates by osc 2 directly (brighter than Primer's FM)
FM depth matched at MIDI note 80 (Primer FM varies with the note)

patches.title: She Blinded Me With Science
notes: mono retriggered LFO in a poly patch: Vital restarts it per voice, so overlapping notes keep their own phase (Primer restarts the one LFO for every sounding note)
